accepted_prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather
Asset type: global authenticated command-center background, nighttime variant, for the fictional cross-platform strategy game SHADOWGRID
Input images: Image 1 is the approved daytime command-center edit target.
Primary request: Change only the time of day and corresponding physically plausible lighting so the same fictional command center appears at realistic urban night.
Invariants: preserve the exact architecture, camera position, framing, room geometry, workstation placement, dark blank displays, left-side UI negative space, city layout, materials, proportions, and all object identities from Image 1. Do not add, remove, move, or redesign objects.
Lighting/mood: realistic deep-blue urban night outside; warm interior practical lights and restrained warm-gold edge accents; credible exposure adaptation, subtle reflections, and distant city windows. Maintain readable dark negative space across the left 45% and center. Keep the result analytical and controlled, not ominous.
Color palette: black and anthracite, deep neutral blue-gray, restrained warm gold; no saturated neon and no warning red.
Text: none.
Constraints: no people or faces; no readable displays, data, maps, diagrams, interface panels, text, fake writing, signage, captions, logos, watermarks, signatures, readable plates, addresses, flags, uniforms, authorities, weapons, crime symbols, or real brands. Preserve suitability beneath a dense real UI and a narrow mobile cover crop.
Avoid: geometry drift, extra furniture, newly illuminated screen content, sci-fi holograms, excessive neon, crushed black detail, blown highlights, fantasy skyline, cartoon, anime, comic, plastic mobile-game rendering, blur, low resolution, compression artifacts.
notes: Architecture, camera, workstation placement, blank displays and UI-safe negative space remain consistent with the daytime asset.
Only physically plausible time-of-day lighting, reflections and distant city windows changed.
No visible person, text, map, interface, logo, private identifier, authority mark, weapon or illicit activity.
